final: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval AS k, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS r FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS bm FROM g WHERE r IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.r - b.bm) AS avg_margin FROM g, b WHERE g.r > b.bm
